selectionEntries.name: Servitors

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

selectionEntries.comment:
SERVITOR PRESENTATION: displayed in the Leader section to match the army rules PDF, while retaining semantic Other / Infantry identity, normal Additional Copy Costs, and no Leader Capacity marker.
SERVITOR ATTACHMENT: uses the proven Cryptothralls attached-by pattern. Exactly one eligible Tech-Priest Leader must attach to the Servitors unit.
SERVITOR LOADOUT: 1-4 models at 10 Points per model. Every model has its own ranged/tool and melee choices. Ranged/tool choices deliberately begin at (None) because every Servitor must use a different ranged/tool weapon. Once a ranged/tool weapon is chosen on one model, that option disappears from the other unconfigured model slots; defensive constructive errors catch duplicate imported/stale states.

rules.name: Attachment Requirement
rules.description: This unit must be attached by a leader unit.

catalogue.comment:
LAYER 0.1 — FOUNDATION
Imported every native Adeptus Mechanicus unit from the Universal Unit Skeleton with its minimum legal points cost, semantic unit type, Infantry/Vehicle/Monster class, Rare status, Leader Capacity marker, and Other soft-copy marker as applicable. Native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs. No native Monster units are present in the source skeleton. Servitors use the proven Cryptothralls attached-by architecture: exactly one eligible Tech-Priest Leader must attach to them, while those Leaders may remain unattached instead. Skitarii Marshal uses the normal mandatory Leader attachment pattern to Skitarii Rangers or Skitarii Vanguards. Detailed loadouts, variable-size expansion controls, and Manufactorum Imperium are intentionally deferred.

LAYER 0.2 — MANUFACTORUM IMPERIUM / ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLES
Added a dedicated Manufactorum Imperium library link and a permanent Configuration control with two independent source switches: Space Marines Vehicles and Astra Militarum Vehicles, both defaulting to Not Included. Space Marines Vehicles is a placeholder only. Astra Militarum Vehicles reveals a bespoke army-list category containing every Vehicle unit from audited Astra Militarum Rev18. There is no Manufactorum-specific numerical cap. Already-included imported units use safe-hide behavior and constructive errors if the source switch is disabled or the Configuration entry is deleted. Imported non-Rare Other vehicles continue to use normal Additional Copy Costs; imported Rare/Leader semantics are preserved by the library unit tree.

REV3 — GAME SYSTEM MANUFACTORUM CATEGORIES
Retargeted to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System Rev14. Removed the catalogue-local Space Marines Vehicles and Astra Militarum Vehicles category definitions and retargeted Manufactorum entryLinks to the canonical Game System presentation categories. The two Configuration switches, Astra Militarum vehicle visibility, safe-hide logic, constructive warnings, imported unit semantics, and Additional Copy Costs remain unchanged.

LAYER 0.3 — SERVITORS REV4
Moved Servitors into the visible Leader section while preserving semantic Other / Infantry and Additional Copy Costs behavior. Implemented the complete 1-4 model Servitor loadout. Each ranged/tool slot begins at (None), the source's 'different weapon for each model' restriction is structurally enforced across the four model slots, and constructive errors cover unconfigured or duplicate weapon states. Additional Servitors cost 10 Points each. Melee choices remain repeatable and default to Arc Claw.

LAYER 0.4 — COMPLETE NATIVE LOADOUTS REV5
Implemented player-facing loadouts for every remaining native Adeptus Mechanicus unit while preserving Rev4 Servitors and Manufactorum Imperium. Skitarii Rangers/Vanguards use Alpha + Warriors 2-9 + dedicated Gunner presentation, with Gunners defaulting to Transuranic Arquebus. Kataphrons use explicit per-model Right Arm / Left Arm slots and optional third models. Thallax Cohort uses one dedicated Special Weapons Loadout model. Ursarax models are represented separately. Raiders use Raider Alpha. Vultarax abbreviates the two Setheno Pattern Havoc Launchers as Setheno Pattern Havoc Launcher 1-2. All other variable-size, paid-wargear, fixed-equipment, and per-model loadout structures were completed from the UUS/PDF.
